items.title: Freeport-McMoRan Chief Accounting Officer Sells $334,000 Worth of Stock
items.summary: Ellie L. Mikes liquidated 4,773 shares at $70 per share, reducing her direct holdings by 12% after the stock surged 73% over the past year. Her remaining position consists entirely of restricted stock units.
